subject: Processor addition notice — Acme Retail (procurement + eSign coordination)
body:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@acmeretail.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@acmeretail.com, J. Patel <j.patel@acmeretail.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Notice of new subprocessor: BlueStream Analytics (30d objection window)

Hi Lauren —

Per Section 3.2 of the DPA we have on file, Acme will be onboarding a new analytics provider, BlueStream Analytics, to process anonymized metrics from the Redwood integration. Please see the attached processor_list_v3.xlsx for the proposed change and the security summary for BlueStream.

Summary: BlueStream will receive aggregate usage metrics (no customer PII), will be hosted in US-East, and will only process logs to generate product-usage reports. We plan to start ingest on 2027-01-10.

We are sending the 30-day notice now; please raise any objections in writing prior to 2027-01-31 per the DPA's subprocessor objection process. If you have required evidence (SOC/TLS certs) we can share additional docs through the procurement portal or via DocuSign secure link.

Attachments: [Attachment: processor_list_v3.xlsx (xlsx, 56KB)]

Thanks,
Maria Gonzalez
Sr. Procurement Manager
Acme Retail

---

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@acmeretail.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 13:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Notice of new subprocessor: BlueStream Analytics (30d objection window)

Hi Maria —

Thanks for the heads up and the attachment. Quick acknowledgement from our side: we will review for data flow impact and any contractual objections. My ask to the team is below.

Action items (internal):
- Karthik: please confirm whether the proposed processing falls within our permitted subprocessors clause and whether we need additional contractual guarantees or a subprocessor addendum.
- Soojin: can you run BlueStream through our security checklist (SOC/ISO cert verification and data retention controls) and flag any red items by 2026-12-08?
- Aditya: I'll need you to coordinate the procurement ask — if Acme requires a signature or DocuSign flow for acceptance, confirm the required recipient and who signs from Redwood.

Maria — we'll aim to get back with either silent-acceptance confirmation or an objection by 2026-12-15 to keep things moving; if we need more time we'll let you know immediately. Also — please send any BlueStream evidence links (SOC reports or attestation) directly to Soojin.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Partnerships (Americas)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redlines_lauren_comments.pdf referenced but internal]

---

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2026 10:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: BlueStream — DPA scope & objection assessment

Lauren / Soojin / Aditya —

Reviewed the processor_list_v3.xlsx and the short security note Maria attached. High-level thoughts:

- Processing type: telemetry & aggregate analytics (no PII). That generally sits within our allowed processor categories given the existing DPA.
- Data transfer risk: BlueStream will be US-hosted (US-East) — no cross-border transfer changes required. Confirmed.
- Contractual gap: we do not currently have a signed subprocessor agreement between Redwood and BlueStream; we'll need a standard subprocessor flow-down or rely on Acme's contract scope. If Acme requires Redwood to sign separate terms with BlueStream, that is a procurement/legal negotiation.

Objection bar: Given current facts, I do not see a privacy/legal basis to object on substantive grounds. The security review (Soojin) will determine residual operational risk. For timeline: if Soojin clears by 12/08 and no red flags, we should provide silent acceptance. If Soojin flags items that require contractual commitments (e.g., specific retention limits or audit rights), we should raise a focused objection and propose a mitigation (e.g., log retention cap or subprocessor addendum).

Please prepare a short, external-facing summary if we need to propose mitigations; otherwise we'll send a silent acceptance message that references the DPA clause and confirms no objection.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2026 16:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: BlueStream — DPA scope & objection assessment

Quick scan completed. Findings:
- BlueStream: SOC2 Type II report dated 2026-06 available (redacted link requested).
- Encryption: in transit TLS 1.2+, at-rest AES-256 available.
- Retention policy: default 365 days for raw logs; can configure down to 90 days on request (paid tier).
- Access controls: role-based access + 2FA for admin console.

Operational notes: retention default is a potential policy mismatch if Acme expects sub-90-day retention as part of contractual guarantees. Karthik — if we want to require retention <= 90 days we should request that in the objection and offer a compensating configuration step rather than block the processor outright.

Recommendation: silent acceptance unless Acme requires us to sign a separate contract with BlueStream or insists on a shorter retention window. Ask procurement (Aditya) to confirm whether Acme expects Redwood to execute anything via DocuSign or whether they will handle the subprocessor agreement with BlueStream directly.

Soojin
VP, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

---

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@acmeretail.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Notice of new subprocessor: BlueStream Analytics (30d objection window)

Hi Maria —

Thanks — we completed our internal review. Summary below and next steps.

Summary: Redwood does not object to BlueStream Analytics being added as a subprocessor for Acme's Redwood integration. Soojin confirmed acceptable controls (SOC2 Type II on record, TLS/AES in place) and retention is configurable. Karthik confirmed no legal bar to acceptance under our DPA.

Conditions & coordination:
- Please confirm whether Acme or BlueStream will host the signed evidence (SOC report). If you'd like Redwood to receive a direct redacted SOC2, we can accept it via DocuSign/secure upload.
- Retention: we request BlueStream be configured to retain raw logs for no more than 90 days for Acme's tenant; if Acme cannot configure that, please provide the business justification in writing.
- Signing: if Acme requires Redwood signature on any addendum, please send the DocuSign packet to legal@redwood.ai and cc lauren_bishop@redwood.ai. If Acme handles the subprocessor contract with BlueStream directly, please include Redwood's legal contact for visibility.

I've attached a short redline summary (redlines_lauren_comments.pdf) for internal reference and a proposed external acceptance note below — feel free to use it in your procurement system.

---External-facing acceptance text (copy-paste)---
Redwood Inference — Subprocessor Acceptance Notice
Redwood has reviewed the proposed addition of BlueStream Analytics. Based on the information provided and our internal review, Redwood does not object to the proposed subprocessor and confirms that the processing described falls within the scope of the parties' existing DPA. To complete onboarding Redwood requests (1) confirmation of SOC2 evidence or a secure link to the report; and (2) configuration of retention to 90 days for Acme data where possible. If Acme requires Redwood signature on a subprocessor addendum, please submit the DocuSign packet to legal@redwood.ai.
---

DocuSign coordination: If you prefer an e-sign flow for evidence receipt or subprocessor addendum, use the link below (we accept DocuSign packets) and address the signature request to legal@redwood.ai with the subject line: "ACM-4721 — Subprocessor Addendum".

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/secure/participant/1234567890

Attachments: [Attachment: redlines_lauren_comments.pdf (pdf, 48KB)], [Attachment: acme_esign_form.docx (docx, 12KB)]

Thanks and happy to jump on a 15-min call tomorrow if you want to walk through the requests.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Partnerships (Americas)
Redwood Inference

>
